fields.Name: T201 - Edit Event Location and Save
fields.Description: Edits a text field (Location) on an Event record and saves, verifying the edit-and-save path persists a change.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity grid — type 'Events' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the exact 'Events' node (or, if the search is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Events). Click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'. Change the 'Location' text field to 'Updated Test Location 201' (clear it first if needed). An unsaved-changes banner with a 'Save Changes' button appears at the TOP of the form when a field is modified — click 'Save Changes'. Verify the save succeeds (a confirmation appears or the banner clears with no error). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Location field was changed on an Event record form
Save Changes was clicked and the save succeeded (confirmation shown or unsaved-changes banner cleared)
No error messages, validation failures, or crash pages
